title: VersionNegotiationResponseHostLinkMethods
description: The VersionNegotiationResponse a Host sends when it advertises the reserved HostLink methods it serves. Same record and decoder as version_negotiation_response; this pair pins the capability-carrying shape.

items.description: A reserved HostLink method name such as hostlink.attach; Core enforces the 256-byte identifier limit and tolerates a name it does not know.
